steps.instruction: Open the reviewed Pipedrive login entry. Do not submit credentials until the owner has supplied them through the encrypted login boundary.
Submit the stored login credentials at most once. Preserve the same session for any human challenge, then navigate directly to Personal preferences > API.

When the API-token field or a reviewed Create/Generate control is visible, enter the code-owned secret-capture boundary. Under create_if_missing, generate the token if absent; the trusted broker may reveal and capture it directly to the vault. Never expose plaintext, rotate, revoke, log, or return the value.

outreach.approval_reason: A public Freshworks Marketplace app requires code, QA, content, security, and business review; custom customer apps do not.
Help Scout OAuth apps are self-created; this fixed gated-matrix entry remains disabled pending a route reclassification.
Marketing API Advanced Access requires Meta app review and business verification.
Advertising API access and Standard tier require LinkedIn review and organization verification.
A Marketplace Connected App requires partner eligibility and technical, security, and listing review; own-account REST access does not.
A third-party Ramp production app requires sandbox work, security review, and partner approval; own-company credentials remain self-serve.
